SELECT
    i_item_id,
    ca_country,
    ca_state,
    ca_county,
    avg(cast(cs_quantity as decimal(12,2))) AS agg1,
    avg(cast(cs_list_price as decimal(12,2))) AS agg2,
    avg(cast(cs_coupon_amt as decimal(12,2))) AS agg3,
    avg(cast(cs_sales_price as decimal(12,2))) AS agg4,
    avg(cast(cs_net_profit as decimal(12,2))) AS agg5,
    avg(cast(c_birth_year as decimal(12,2))) AS agg6,
    avg(cast(cd1.cd_dep_count as decimal(12,2))) AS agg7
FROM catalog_sales
JOIN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 2001) AS date_dim
    ON catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
JOIN (SELECT cd_demo_sk, cd_dep_count
      FROM customer_demographics
      WHERE cd_gender = 'F' AND cd_education_status = 'Primary') AS cd1
    ON catalog_sales.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd1.cd_demo_sk
JOIN (
    SELECT cust.c_customer_sk,
           cust.c_birth_year,
           addr.ca_country,
           addr.ca_state,
           addr.ca_county
    FROM customer AS cust
    JOIN (SELECT ca_address_sk, ca_country, ca_state, ca_county
          FROM customer_address
          WHERE ca_state IN ('AL','MO','TN','GA','MT','IN','CA')) AS addr
        ON cust.c_current_addr_sk = addr.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics AS cd2
        ON cust.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd2.cd_demo_sk
    WHERE cust.c_birth_month IN (1,3,7,11,10,4)
) AS cust_addr
    ON catalog_sales.cs_bill_customer_sk = cust_addr.c_customer_sk
JOIN item
    ON catalog_sales.cs_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
GROUP BY ROLLUP (i_item_id, ca_country, ca_state, ca_county)
ORDER BY ca_country, ca_state, ca_county, i_item_id
LIMIT 100
